    if (step + 1) % optimizer.ema_interval == 0 or finished:
        with torch.no_grad():
            parameters = [
                parameter
                for group in optimizer.param_groups
                for parameter in group["params"]
            ]
            for average, parameter in zip(
                optimizer.ema_parameters,
